edits.label: General next-action hierarchy and controls
Use shared styling for inspection cards
edits.newText: /* Inspection cards use the shared next-action typography and focus styles. */

edits.label: Responsive action layout follows available lab width
Focus color follows the control surface
edits.newText: [data-dissection-root] .diss-next-action :is(button:focus-visible, #diss-next-action-title:focus) { outline: 3px solid var(--diss-next-action-focus, #1766d2); outline-offset: -5px; box-shadow: none; }
